availability_semantics.expensive_work: availability never triggers model inference or simulation; provider supports() checks only

cache_policy: exact-key in-memory result cache keyed by (race_id, anchor_lap_number, anchor_state_time_s); availability never populates the cache; fixture records act as pre-seeded deterministic cache sources; no TTL/eviction controls exposed; corruption fails loudly as 503, never silent fallback

disagreement_definitions.leader: C leader_set per source over the common driver universe; exact_leader_match on sorted tie-safe sets; ties never broken
disagreement_definitions.rank: C descending average_ranks per source over the common driver universe; rank_displacement = simulation_rank minus model_rank via C rank_displacement
disagreement_definitions.sampling_context: C mc_sampling_se + wilson_interval per simulated driver from valid_trials; labelled FINITE_MC_SAMPLING_CONTEXT_ONLY
disagreement_definitions.top_k: C topk_set boundary-tie semantics (default k=3) + jaccard; WIN-ranking overlap, NOT P(finish<=k)

consensus_unsupported.when: well-formed exact state a source cannot serve, incl. explicit 2025 PRODUCT_EXCLUDED refusal

internal.when: anything else; never disguised as client error; no stack traces/paths/internals

parameter_unavailable.when: fixture/cache artifact missing or corrupt; fail loudly, never benign unsupported

unknown_state.when: well-formed race with no exact anchor state

excluded_sources: XGBOOST (secondary diagnostic only, not a runtime arm)

probability_families.MC2_E: MUTUALLY_EXCLUSIVE_SIMULATION_FREQUENCY, target WIN; winner frequencies sum to one by construction over a valid simulated field; never reinterpreted as Logistic-family probability
probability_families.V3_1B_LOGISTIC: INDEPENDENT_BINARY, target WIN; frozen raw positive-class probability; never race-normalized/softmaxed/simplex-projected

public_science_controls: none: providers take the anchor only; no seed, simulation-count, variance-mode, or configuration parameters exist on any F schema/service path
refusal_policy: fail closed with typed reason from the frozen B ReasonCode vocabulary; missing sources stay null/absent, never zero; supported MC2 zeros stay numeric 0.0; unsupported drivers never silently dropped

runtime_source_registry.MC2_E: fixture/injected provider arm (demonstration fixture values are verbatim V3.8D MC2-E records)
runtime_source_registry.V3_1B_LOGISTIC: fixture/injected provider arm (demonstration fixture values are verbatim frozen Logistic records)

support_semantics: per-source AVAILABLE/UNAVAILABLE with B ReasonCode; comparison COMPARABLE only when both AVAILABLE; supported simulated-but-winless driver -> numeric 0.0 (not unavailable); missing source -> null/absent (never 0)
temporal_alignment: exact (race_id, anchor_lap_number, anchor_state_time_s) identity; both arms keyed by identical state identities per B exact-identity semantics; no interpolation, no future lookup, no forward fill, no outcome labels, no D/E ground truth in runtime
year_policy_2025: REVEALED_HOLDOUT / NON_PRISTINE / PRODUCT_EXCLUDED: availability reports both sources UNAVAILABLE/NOT_COMPARABLE; compare refuses 422 consensus_unsupported STATE_NOT_AVAILABLE; no research artifact may extend product support
